plainLanguage: Section 81 — Rioters demolishing buildings, etc. — ni sehemu ya mfumo wa Chapter IX unaohusu unlawful assemblies, riots na public tranquility.
meaning: It criminalises specified destruction or beginning to destroy buildings, railway, machinery or structures by persons riotously assembled.
keyPoints: Covers pulling down, destroying, or beginning to do so.
Specified targets include buildings, railway, machinery and structures.

history.summary: Section 81 appears in Chapter IX of The Penal Code [CAP. 16 R.E. 2022].
notes: Text verified against the R.E. 2022 government-hosted Penal Code.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Each statutory threshold and sequence should be proved from evidence.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: Requirements such as reasonable time, authorised actors and reasonable necessity materially limit the provision's operation.

debateQuestion: Je, statutory conditions zote za section 81 zimetimizwa kwa facts husika?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
